An ordered journey, not four counters

Same session, strictly increasing event positions. A contact action before a project does not become a downstream conversion.

    Rates use all eligible sessions. Visitors can take other paths; this sequence describes one journey and does not explain causation.

    Where sessions begin

    Acquisition and landing page use the first event in time, with event ID as the tie-breaker. Later direct events cannot overwrite that source.

      Project attention and later actions

      One session-project pair per row. Repeated project views do not inflate the denominator. A later action is associated with a project; it is not attributed lift.

      Selected window; deep means at least 45 summed project-event seconds
      Project Sessions Deep sessions Later-action sessions

      Return cohorts with an observation boundary

      Full 90-day fixture history, independent of the analysis selector. Monday-based cohorts are defined by first observed activity. Each cell shows returning users / cohort users. Incomplete weeks remain unavailable, even if activity has already arrived.

      Observed weekly return, not cumulative retention or real evaluator behavior
      First observed week Users W0 W1 W2 W3 W4

      A zero is an observed absence; an em dash means the full week has not elapsed. The fixture cannot establish real-world retention or business lift.
